title: 58 - News
summary: With under a third of his journey behind him, [[character:howard]] reads an email from [[character:dexter]]. [[character:george-butterworth|Butterworth]] has retired, the system's population has reached about 100,000, ships with human crews are becoming common and the [[technology:kudzu-gardens|farm donuts]] supply a shrinking share of its food. With unexpected spare time, Dexter is building several of [[character:bill]]'s [[technology:asteroid-mover|asteroid movers]]. New Jerusalem is now a democracy: after incriminating videos leaked, [[character:cranston|Cranston]] was forced to resign and the citizens again separated religious from civil authority. Howard is amused, sure that nothing can be traced to him or [[character:riker|Will]], and emails Will for more. Apart from the [[species:others|Others]], he thinks humanity is doing well. Finally he reads the news he had put off: [[character:dr-sheehy|Bridget]] and [[character:stephane-brodeur|Stéphane]] have had a son and named him Howard. Moved to tears, he plans a short note of thanks.
